The client-owned generator, pinned dependency, lock entry, and raw retirement already existed at the slice base. This commit adds tarball consumer and property-removal evidence and removes the Dashboard TypeScript path bypass; no lockfile or generated artifact is modified.

The static Runtime Reference Shell and two package-local tests import canonical filenames directly. The census found no raw filename imports. The shell is documented as a separate static diagnostics UI and is outside the installed Dashboard/Atlas consumer assertion.
The tarball and isolated npm consumer projects are temporary test artifacts and were cleaned after the test; the implementation commit reproduces them, and no package was published.
The missing-catalog integration result and full OpenAPI export drift are not established as inherited because neither was replayed from the exact slice base.
Deployed endpoint execution, production authorization behavior, all API operations, hosted CI, and external filesystem consumers were not established.
